actions.text: Committee on Veterans' Affairs. Ordered to be reported with an amendment in the nature of a substitute favorably.

dimensions.assessment: Applies to immediate family members or designated representatives of deceased veterans and TRICARE enrollees, as well as DOD and VA record systems.
dimensions.evidence: an individual designated by such deceased enrollee; or... an immediate family member of such deceased enrollee.

dimensions.assessment: Permits adding supplemental health information without modifying existing records or altering benefit eligibility provisions directly.
dimensions.evidence: Any update under subsection (a) shall supplement information contained in the health records... and shall not modify information contained in such records.

dimensions.assessment: No specific costs or appropriations are mentioned in the source material.
Directs the Secretary of Defense and Secretary of Veterans Affairs to jointly establish a designation process and update record systems.
dimensions.evidence: the Secretary of Defense and the Secretary of Veterans Affairs shall jointly take actions necessary to ensure that the health records... may be updated

dimensions.assessment: Mandates an initial implementation deadline of one year, followed by permanent availability of the record supplementation process.
dimensions.evidence: Not later than one year after the date of the enactment of this Act, the Secretary of Defense and the Secretary of Veterans Affairs shall jointly take actions

missing_information: Cost estimates for modifying DOD and VA electronic health record systems to accept supplementary entries.
Number of deceased enrollees whose families are expected to use this provision.
importance_detail.rationale: Requires the Departments of Defense and Veterans Affairs to allow designated individuals or immediate family members to supplement the health records of deceased veterans and TRICARE enrollees with observed health conditions.
